text: The apd operation apd_f for a dependent function f: Π(x:A).B(x) and p:a=b gives:
choices: a path f(a) = f(b) in B(a)
transport^B(p, f(a)) = f(b) — a path over p in B
a path ap_f(p) in the codomain
explanation: apd_f(p) : transport^B(p, f(a)) = f(b). This is the dependent version of ap. It says f 'respects' p over the fibration B.
